# Dédalo

> Graphical control panel (PySide6) for orchestrating AI agents
> (opencode, codex, claude) that iterate on tasks from a `plan.md`, run
> tests (`gate.sh`), request code review and commit automatically.
> Supports Linux (validated), macOS and Windows (CI-tested, not yet validated by hand), and exposes an MCP server (pilot agent).

This file summarizes, for a language model, what the project is and where
each thing lives. We prefer you cite the technical spec as the source of truth.

## Documentation
- [Technical spec](docs/FICHA_TECNICA.md): requirements, dependencies, per-OS artifacts, MCP surface and security. **Start here.**
- [README](README.md): installation, usage, shortcuts, loop variables and compatibility.
- [MCP guide](docs/MCP.md): all 18 tools, client configuration, resources and pilot workflow.
- [Known bugs](docs/BUGS_CONOCIDOS.md): defects found and decided not to fix now.
- [Manual test](packaging/PRUEBA-MANUAL.md): step-by-step validation per OS.

## Key points
- Requirements: Python 3.10+; deps `PySide6`, `pyqtgraph`; optional extra `mcp`.
- Install: `bash install.sh` (creates `.venv`, installs `-e ".[mcp]"`, desktop shortcut).
- Run the GUI: `./lanzar.sh` or `python -m dedalo`.
- Loop (Python engine): `python -m dedalo.loop` (or `--dedalo-loop` on the binary).
- MCP over stdio: `python -m dedalo.mcp_server` (source only, not in the `.exe`).
- User config: `~/.config/dedalo/proyectos.json` (registry) and `panel.conf` (QSettings).
- Project layout: framework scripts and run state live under `.dedalo/`
  (`scripts/`, `estado/`, `review/`); `plan.md`, `lecciones.md`, `CONTEXTO.md`
  and `gate_checks/` are project-owned. Legacy root layouts are migrated on load.
- Release binaries are not code-signed; each Release carries Sigstore build provenance.
- Safety: the project gate needs first-run consent (per project), manual review cannot be self-approved by an agent, and `--push` never pushes the base branch.
